title: Ex 1.1 #14 · {5x : x ∈ ℤ, |2x| ≤ 8}
prompt: Write the set $\{5x : x \in \mathbb{Z}, |2x| \le 8\}$ by listing its elements between braces.
answer_format: A set listed between braces, like {1, 2, 3} (∅ for the empty set). Steps are optional.

mistakes.hint: Those are the values of x. The elements of this set are 5x.

hints: First find the integers x with |2x| ≤ 8.
The elements are 5x for each of those integers, not x itself.
solution: |2x| ≤ 8 means −4 ≤ x ≤ 4. Multiplying each of the integers −4, …, 4 by 5 gives the elements.

reference.note: This exact exercise, restated in ProofLab's words.
